question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted now as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin, or should this issue wait for a richer gateway activity/progress contract before closing?
rationale: The issue is coherent and has an open implementation candidate, but the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, and attention state is a product/API sequencing choice.

options.title: Review the staged builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate fix and close this issue only if that PR or a replacement lands.

options.title: Wait for activity contract
options.body: Keep the issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 defines the richer session activity/progress API the widget should consume.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Move any unique requirements to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 and let the dashboard roadmap own sequencing.

recommendation.title: Review the staged builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the candidate fix and close this issue only if that PR or a replacement lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is the current bundled Control UI plugin-tab seam and dashboard product acceptance path.
